info.name: Crunchbase Data API v4 Autocomplete Search API

params.name: collection
params.description: The core entity collection (e.g. organizations, people, funding_rounds, acquisitions).

items.docs: Searches a collection (organizations, people, funding_rounds, acquisitions, and others) using a JSON body of field_ids to return and an array of query filters combined with AND logic. Returns 50 items by default and up to 1000 per request, with keyset pagination via after_id or before_id.
